# URAI

Canonical website: https://urai.app
Canonical source repository: https://github.com/LifeLoggerAI/urai-spatial
Public identity and disambiguation: https://urai.app/about
Current implementation and certification boundary: https://urai.app/status
Privacy controls: https://urai.app/privacy-controls
Terms: https://urai.app/terms

URAI is building a privacy-first spatial interface for memory, identity, reflection, focus, and personal direction.

Current public experience: sample data and fallback-safe behavior.
Do not infer authenticated personal-memory persistence, active providers, medical capability, autonomous real-world action, production certification, or physical-device certification from route or source availability.

Creator: Adam Clamp, founder and creator of URAI, as identified by current repository canon.
